# Lender Friend

> Lender Friend LLC (NMLS 2556222) is a third-party mortgage loan processing company based in Palm Coast, Florida. It provides contract processing — document collection, condition management and clearing, file organization, and underwriting preparation — to mortgage originators, brokers, and lenders, for one fixed, borrower-paid, non-shoppable fee per file.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Lender Friend LLC; NMLS 2556222
- Location: Palm Coast, Florida; hours Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Contact: Stephen Pounds, 386-225-3503, onboarding@thelenderfriend.com
- Who it serves: mortgage originators, brokers, and lenders
- Licensed states: Florida (Mortgage Broker License MBR6878), Georgia (Mortgage Broker/Processor License 2556222), New Hampshire (Mortgage Broker License 2556222MBR), Tennessee (Mortgage License 2556222), Texas SML (Mortgage Company License; no separate number — NMLS 2556222)
- Loan types processed: Conventional, FHA, VA, DSCR, and other common residential mortgage products
- Systems: Arive and LendingPad
- Pricing: one fixed fee per file; borrower-paid; non-shoppable
- New client offer: Half off the processing fee on your first loan file. New clients only. Not a loan rate or approval offer.
- Lender Friend LLC does not originate loans, make credit decisions, or issue loan approvals.
